1-15231-2-1.subevent: A mortar attack occurred in northern Faryab province on Thursday morning.
At least four civilians were killed and 10 others were wounded in the attack.
The incident happened around 11:00am local time after a mortar round landed in a market in Shareen Tagab district.
Abdul Karim Yourish, a spokesman for the provincial police chief, said the mortar was fired 'by the Taliban' to target security forces.
Yourish added that all the victims were civilians who were at the market to shop.
The Taliban has not commented on the attack.

0-4495-1-1.subevent: Tunisia Youth Impact uses cooking contests to encourage rural women to vote in the presidential election.
On October 12, a Voticook cooking contest is held in the rural town of Echamine.
The national turnout in the first round of the election was 48.98%.
Wafa Tarhouni explains that the contest is a practice vote where women compete through their dishes.
Volunteers mimic real voting conditions, replacing ink with a water and shampoo mixture.
The contest is held at the home of Hinda Jlass, who is participating.
Hinda Jlass says the event is about getting together and plans to vote in the election for the second time.
Seven competitors present their dishes to about fifty electors.
Electors taste the dishes and vote using the same procedure as the real election.
ISIE members and EU observer Stefan Ziegler are present; Ziegler says it is good for Tunisian democracy.
After voting, ballots are counted and volunteers point out potential mistakes.
Najwa Jlass wins the contest and says she will vote in the real election.
